sum_insured_options: ₹3,00,000 (illustrated; exact options not fully specified in wording)

room_rent.note: If a higher room category is chosen, Associate Medical Expenses are pro-rated in proportion to the difference in room rent.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of hospitalisation expenses; no specific sub-limit mentioned for ICU.

copayment.note: Special Condition 2: 20% co-payment applies if entry age of insured (or eldest insured for floater) is ≥60 years at first policy issuance.

sub_limits.note: Maternity (Benefit 4) and Newborn (Benefit 5) have limits as per Policy Schedule. Ambulance has a specified limit per Policy Schedule. No broad disease-wise sub-limits mentioned beyond these.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT disorders, BPH, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Benefit 4: Maternity cover with 24-month waiting period for Joy Tomorrow. Insured must be ≤45 years. Limit as per Policy Schedule. Pre-natal and post-natal expenses included. Voluntary termination before 12 weeks not covered. Ectopic pregnancy covered under Benefit 1.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonanza is an optional cover (Optional Cover 1). Provides 100% of SI after 3 consecutive claim-free years. Inbuilt cumulative bonus not mentioned; this is entirely optional.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered under Benefit 1 conditions (patient unable to be moved or no hospital room available).

ayush.note: Benefit 7: AYUSH treatments covered up to Sum Insured at recognised AYUSH hospitals within India, subject to in-patient admissibility.

organ_donor.note: Exclusion 4.2(b)(xi): All expenses related to donor treatment including surgery to remove organs from donor are excluded.

ambulance.note: Benefit 3: Ambulance cover up to amount specified in Policy Schedule for emergency transport to nearest hospital.

modern_treatments.note: Benefit 1(d): Advance Technology Methods including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, etc. covered under Benefit 1.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists non-medical/consumable items (gloves, masks, etc.) as excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Exclusion 4.2(b)(xiv): Treatment received outside India is excluded.

notable_exclusions: Organ donor surgery, OPD treatment, overseas treatment, infertility/IVF, external congenital anomaly, ectopic pregnancy (under maternity only), tobacco/alcohol-related illness
optional_riders: No Claim Bonanza (100% SI after 3 claim-free years)
